site.name: The Beachconers Microcreamery
site.tagline: Handcrafted Ice Cream & Coffee · Britannia, Ottawa
site.address_note: Free parking · Steps from Britannia Beach
site.about_title: Ice cream & coffee — our love language
site.about_p1: The Beachconers was born from a simple belief: ice cream and coffee should be made the way your grandmother would — from scratch, with real ingredients, and a lot of love. All made from scratch in small batches.
site.about_p2: Nestled steps from Britannia Beach on the Ottawa River, we've been hand-crafting small-batch ice cream and pulling specialty espresso for 19 years. Every flavour is developed in-house and made fresh each morning.
site.about_p3: We source locally whenever possible — Ontario dairy farms, seasonal fruit growers, and independent suppliers who care as much as we do. Come find us by the water.
